title: hushrun.ready/v2
description: Output of `hushrun ready --format json` (spec C-22): what CI would still run on this exact code, and the commands that run it here first. It exits 0 when no check is missing and 10 when one is; with --strict, 0 only when a check is known and every check passed. [ADR 0062] v2 has no stage.

revision.description: The commit looked at; null for the worktree of a repository with no commit yet.

branch.description: The branch the code goes to, when one is known.

ready.description: Whether no check is missing; with --strict, whether a check is known and every check passed.

check.description: The check's name; <scope>/<check> when hushrun.yaml has several scopes.

state.description: passed: CI skips it; with `results` local, a run here skips it. missing: it hasn't passed on this code, and `run` runs it here, where a counts_from rule on a tool is the run's to judge; with no `run` when it failed here or elsewhere and a run here wouldn't count, so that `why` says what clears it. ci: nothing here changes it, and CI or another machine has to run it.

why.description: Why it isn't passed. For a check with no result whose run here under a counts_from rule didn't count, `a run here didn't count: <what the run said>`: that stands for this code on this machine while the key has no result, and `hushrun ready` read it from that run, starting nothing.

run.description: The command that runs it here, for a missing check a run here can clear.

recordedBy.description: [ADR 0045] Who recorded a passed check's result, as the server says: never read from the result itself. Null when the server doesn't say, and for any other state.

reports.description: [ADR 0048] What a passed check's pass said of its test and coverage reports (spec C-27), as its result holds it. Left out without one.

files.description: The report files read, at most 16, by path from the repository root, /-separated, each at most 160 bytes; left out when none fits.

format.description: junit, trx, lcov, cobertura, jacoco, clover, opencover, go, coveragepy, istanbul or simplecov; another word from a newer hushrun.

filesLeftOut.description: The report files read that `files` leaves out; left out when none is.

filesComplete.description: [ADR 0048] `files` names every report file the search found, each read, and the search went everywhere the job's readers read (spec C-26, C-27); left out otherwise.

tests.description: When a test-results file was read: its tests, `failed` and `errors` apart, and how long they took when the files say.

coverage.description: When a coverage file was read: its format, and the lines (statements, for Go's) and branches it covered, each left out when it counts nothing.

results.description: [ADR 0067] Where the results of the runs it looked up are, as `hushrun run` chooses (spec C-11): shared, on a server CI reads too; local, on this machine only, so that passed means a run here skips it and CI runs every check all the same; off. Left out when it looked up no run, and by a hushrun from before it.

next.description: The commands to run, in order.

notes.description: What else to know before running them.
